Jack Andersson
jack.andersson@example.com | Cincinnati, OH
Jack Andersson has 7 years of experience in backend and distributed systems.
Most recently, Senior Backend Engineer at Sable Cloud (2025-2026), where they
owned the Kafka event pipeline processing 57M events/day. Before that, Backend
Engineer at Hollowbrook Systems (2022-2025). Before that, Software Engineer I
at Harborlight Infrastructure (2019-2022). Education: B.S. Computer
Engineering, University of Washington, 2018. Core skills: Java, REST API
design, PostgreSQL, Docker, AWS.
